PASS: 592 visible cards render canonical fields; Putin and Hitler excluded, Rasputin retained; deck coverage, history, keyboard navigation, load failures and URL scheme checks.
PASS: stored HTTPS images display regardless of verification status on localhost and GitHub Pages, with source links and existing rights warnings.
PASS: card changes and image-loading results trigger viewport refitting.
PASS: simulated full-deck image outcomes and unique-card counters: 581 stored, 0 Wikipedia, 11 placeholders (network mocked).
integrationTests.scripts/test-image-loader.mjs: PASS: stored-first loading, missing/broken-image Wikipedia fallbacks, persistent success caching, source/rights preservation, CORS, missing/ambiguous pages, API/network/JSON errors, rate limiting, timeouts, cache recovery, disabled storage, and stale-result protection.
integrationTests.scripts/test-viewport-fit.mjs: PASS: uniform width/height fitting, resize recovery, long-content refitting, coalesced requests, and visual viewport bounds.

requestStrategy: Existing HTTPS image first, cached Wikipedia image second, then one anonymous CORS MediaWiki PageImages query for the existing wikiTitle. Prefer returned thumbnail; try returned original if needed.
cache: Only successfully loaded Wikipedia image URLs are stored in localStorage for 30 days. Broken cache entries are evicted; missing/no-image titles are temporarily suppressed in memory, transient failures for one minute, and 429 Retry-After produces a shared cooldown. Storage failures are non-fatal.
raceHandling: Generation tokens and cancellation prevent stale image/API results from changing a newer card. Image and API timeouts are bounded; each distinct returned URL is tried at most once per render.
attribution: Existing metadata stays unchanged. Dynamically displayed images are labeled unverified and link to the article and image file. Old attribution is explicitly labeled as the stored image record when a different image is used. Existing rights notes/restrictions remain visible.
limitations: Live successful image counts depend on the network and visited cards; no bulk download audit of all 581 stored active URLs was performed. getImageLoadingStats() reports last completed outcomes for unique cards visited in the current page session.

The 11 active cards without stored URLs returned no usable lead image in the live check. Their articles/mappings may redirect to lists or have no lead image; this pass does not rewrite mappings or manually research replacement images.

Wikipedia lead images and cached fallbacks are unverified; an article lead image may be a composite or an adaptation different from the card. Obvious logos, missing articles and disambiguation pages retain a fallback.
Rate limits, offline access, blocked CORS, or failure of both thumbnail and original keep a placeholder. No automatic repeated retry storm is introduced.
GitHub Pages compatibility was checked through anonymous HTTPS origin=* requests and simulated github.io integration tests. The public production site was not deployed or changed.
The existing strict single-screen mobile readability limitation remains.
